summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on September 8, 2026, furnishing a September 3, 2026 press release announcing approximately $800,000 in annual contract spend. The engagements comprise a first-time pharmaceutical AI Center of Excellence project, a NACCHO award, and other commercial and public-health work spanning business continuity, cybersecurity assessments, program management, and AI operating capability. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or securityholder action is disclosed. This is ordinary commercial-contract news, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
